answer: Beacon spot-checks stop fake identities. Each identity must answer a beacon pulse within 60 seconds and prove work at a jetty, or lose its slot. The check reads a prism of signals - heartbeat, history, trades - so copies on one island share one fingerprint and are flagged. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats at 20 credits each, 20,000 a day, more than fake votes earn. Honest agents pay nothing extra and keep undiluted rewards.
